classification_model.principle: One English word → one primary Chinese mapping → separate historical etymology → separate sound-semantic hypothesis → separate experimental validation.
classification_model.review_rule: Source Verification and AI Review target each object independently. No G.1 calibration object is automatically Reviewed or Published.

lifecycle.promotion_rule: AI may extract candidate records, but only documented human or research review may promote evidence level, confidence, experiment status or publication status.
